source_instruction: i want silver and noise cancelling earbuds.
query: My cousin just adopted a tiny tabby kitten last week and she’s been obsessing over getting it the perfect feather wand, she even spent three hours comparing different catnip blends last night and keeps sending me blurry photos of the kitten napping on her laptop keyboard. Oh and I saw someone on the bus yesterday eating a matcha croissant that looked so good I’m planning to stop by the bakery after this, I hope they haven’t sold out by the time I get there. Anyway, I’m looking for headphones in this section, they need to have active noise cancelling, I want the white-silver color option, they have to be $30 or under, and make sure they come with a detachable 3.5mm audio cable too.

extras.text: make sure they come with a detachable 3.5mm audio cable too
